Find the derivative of [MATH: y = 3 anh{x}- \sinh{x}.]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits}]

First, we recall the results for the derivatives of the basic hyperbolic functions: [MATH: \dfrac{ extrm{d}}{ extrm{d}x} ( \sinh x ) = \cosh x, \quad \dfrac{ extrm{d}}{ extrm{d}x} ( \cosh x ) = \sinh x, \quad \dfrac{ extrm{d}}{ extrm{d}x} ( anh x ) = \sech^2 x]

Differentiating the given function using these results, we get

[MATH: (dy)/(dx)|= (d)/(dx)(3 anh x − \sinh x); = 3(d)/(dx)( anh x) − (d)/(dx)(\sinh x); = 3sech^{2} x − \cosh x.]

items.title: Differentiating Hyperbolic Functions Using the Chain Rule

sections.normalized_html:
[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits}]

Find the derivative of [MATH: f(x) = \cosh{\sqrt x}.]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
First, we express [MATH: f(x)] as a composite function:

[MATH: f = \cosh g, \qquad g = \sqrt x]

The chain rule states that

[MATH: \dfrac {\textrm{d}f} {\textrm{d}x} = \dfrac {\textrm{d}f} {\textrm{d}g} \cdot \dfrac {\textrm{d}g} {\textrm{d}x}.]

Differentiating, we have

[MATH: \dfrac {\textrm{d}f} {\textrm{d}g} = \sinh g,]

and

[MATH: \dfrac {\textrm{d}g} {\textrm{d}x} = \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt x}.]

Finally, multiplying the two results together and substituting for [MATH: g] gives

[MATH: (df)/(dx)|= \sinh g ⋅ (1)/(2sqrt(x)); = \sinh sqrt(x) ⋅ (1)/(2sqrt(x)); = (\sinh sqrt(x))/(2sqrt(x)).]

[MATH: (df)/(dx)|= \sinh g ⋅ (1)/(2sqrt(x)); = \sinh sqrt(x) ⋅ (1)/(2sqrt(x)); = (\sinh sqrt(x))/(2sqrt(x)).]

Find the derivative of [MATH: f(x) = 2x anh{x}.]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits}]

Here, we have the product of two functions [MATH: u(x) = 2x] and [MATH: v(x)= anh x.] So, we apply the product rule:

[MATH: f^{′}(x)|= (2x)^{′} ⋅ anh x + 2x ⋅ ( anh x)^{′}; = 2 ⋅ anh x + 2x ⋅ sech^{2} x; = 2 anh x + 2xsech^{2} x; = 2( anh x + xsech^{2} x)]

Find the derivative of [MATH: w(x) = \dfrac{x^3}{\cosh{x}}.]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
[MATH: ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits}]

In this case, the expression for [MATH: w(x)] is a quotient [MATH: \dfrac{u(x)}{v(x)}] with [MATH: u(x) = x^3] and [MATH: v(x) = \cosh{x}.]

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows: [MATH: w^{′}(x)|= (u^{′}(x) ⋅ v(x) − u(x) ⋅ v^{′}(x))/([v(x)]^{2}); = ((x^{3})^{′} ⋅ \cosh x − x^{3} ⋅ (\cosh x)^{′})/((\cosh x)^{2}); = (3x^{2} ⋅ \cosh x − x^{3} ⋅ \sinh x)/(\cosh^{2} x); = (x^{2}(3\cosh x − x\sinh x))/(\cosh^{2} x)]
